xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4503: Diff panel: compare any two refs in a local repo (no PR needed), and an ignore-whitespace toggle

plan.title: Diff panel: compare any two refs in a local repo (no PR needed), and an ignore-whitespace toggle
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The two halves (two-ref compare, ignore-whitespace) share the diff panel, the diff helpers and the route files, and PAN-4501 is held by hold-for-uat until PAN-4503 merges: a watcher releases PAN-4501 on this issue's merge, so splitting into sibling issues would let PAN-4501 ship before the whitespace half and break the agreed one-deploy coordination. The surface is 27 files across 5 subsystems, decomposed into 12 small items with a DAG that keeps backend and frontend work parallel.

narratives.Problem: The diff panel can show only per-turn, all-turns and vs-main diffs, so comparing two commits in a local-only repository (no remote, no PR) needs a hand-built popout URL. Every diff path runs git diff without -w, so re-indentation drowns out the real change.
narratives.Proposal: Add GET /api/diffs/compare (two-dot or three-dot, repo path validated against registered project roots, workspaces dirs and exact conversation cwds; refs shape-checked before any git call and diffed only as resolved SHAs) and GET /api/diffs/refs for the picker, both with no-loss matrix rows. Thread a shared DiffOptions { ignoreWhitespace } (query param ignoreWhitespace=1 -> git -w) through every agent and conversation diff helper and route. In the diff panel, add a per-browser ignore-whitespace toggle and a URL-reflected Compare view with a datalist ref picker, also in the popout. Cherry-pick PAN-4501's pure route-move commit so the capped conversations.ts never grows. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4503.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Recomputing turn-summary file lists (GET .../diffs summaries) with -w
- Comparing against the working tree or the index; compare is commit-to-commit only
- A compare-only popout without an agent or conversation prefix (PAN-3178 Changes surface)
- Fixing PAN-4501 gaps: conversation vs-main route, /full file list, configured default branch
- Rename detection in compare file lists (--no-renames is deliberate)
- Converting existing promisify(exec) calls in conversation-diffs.ts to execFile beyond adding the constant -w flag
- Relabeling the vs main chip
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap
- Writing the ignore-whitespace preference into the URL

autoDecisions.summary: A second route, GET /api/diffs/refs, feeds the picker, with its own no-loss matrix row.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for picking from branches, tags and recent commits; the compare response must stay a pure diff, and the picker needs refs before any compare runs.

autoDecisions.summary: The compare response always carries files and carries diff only when file= is given.
autoDecisions.rationale: This is the exact vs-main contract the panel already renders, and it avoids computing a whole-repository patch to show a file list. PAN-3178 renders per file and can reuse it unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: Allowed repositories: inside a registered project root or its workspaces dir, or exactly equal to an unarchived conversation cwd.
autoDecisions.rationale: Exact match for conversation cwds stops a conversation started in the home directory from opening every repository under it, while still covering the motivating local-only scratch repo.
Two-dot is exactly the changes between A and B, which is the operator's local-only straight-line case; three-dot is one click away.

autoDecisions.summary: Turn-summary file lists are not recomputed with -w.
autoDecisions.rationale: Agent summaries are event-sourced at turn time and conversation summaries are cached by transcript stat; patches still honor -w in every view, which satisfies the acceptance criterion.

autoDecisions.summary: Cherry-pick PAN-4501 commit 123a49ab986 instead of inventing a second route extraction.
autoDecisions.rationale: routes/conversations.ts is at its 1072-line cap, so whitespace parsing cannot be added there; reusing PAN-4501's identical move keeps both branches on the same layout and shrinks PAN-4501's rebase conflict to the few changed lines.

autoDecisions.summary: The ref picker uses a native input + datalist.
autoDecisions.rationale: It supports both picking and typing a ref with no new dependency.

autoDecisions.summary: Ignore-whitespace persists in the existing diff preferences in localStorage and is not written to the URL.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says the setting persists per browser; existing diff preferences already live in localStorage key overdeck.ui.diff.preferences.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. Create src/lib/diffs/compare.ts with CompareErrorCode, CompareError, CompareResult<T>, AllowedDiffRoots { containing; exact }, and plain async functions resolveAllowedDiffRoots(), validateRefShape(ref), resolveCompareRepo(repo, roots), resolveCommit(repoRoot, ref). Rules (PRD Decisions D4, D5): containing roots = realpath of each listProjectsSync() config.path plus realpath of resolve(config.path, config.workspace?.workspaces_dir ?? 'workspaces'); exact roots = realpath of each listConversations() cwd; a repo is allowed when realpath(repo) is inside or equal to a containing root, or exactly equal to an exact root. Ref shape: non-empty, at most 256 chars, no leading -, no .., matches /^[A-Za-z0-9._\/@{}~^+-]+$/ ; this check never spawns git. resolveCommit runs execFile git rev-parse --verify --quiet --end-of-options <ref>^{commit}. Import execFile from node:child_process and promisify it; no exec, no execSync. Tests per PRD WI-5 step 5, including a vi.mock pass-through spy on execFile.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6. Add compareRefs({ repoRoot, base, head, mode, file?, options? }) to compare.ts returning CompareResponse { repoRoot, mode, base: {ref, sha}, head: {ref, sha}, mergeBase, files, diff? }: three-dot runs git merge-base (failure = NO_MERGE_BASE) and diffs from the merge base; two-dot diffs from baseSha; file list = git -c core.quotePath=false diff --no-renames --numstat --no-color ...diffOptionArgs(options) <from> <headSha> plus the same with --name-status (no -w) via parseNumstatWithStatus; diff only when file is given (--patch --minimal, maxBuffer 50MB, `-- <file>`). New route file src/dashboard/server/routes/diff-compare.ts exports createDiffCompareRoutes({ allowedRoots }) and diffCompareRouteLayer (default deps = resolveAllowedDiffRoots); the handler uses validateOrigin from ./origin-validation.js, parses repo/base/head/mode (default two-dot, unknown = INVALID_MODE)/file/ignoreWhitespace, runs validateRefShape on both refs BEFORE resolveCompareRepo, then resolveCommit, then compareRefs; failures return 400 with { code, error }; exceptions return 500. Register diffCompareRouteLayer in server.ts next to diffsRouteLayer and add the matrix row { surface: 'GET /api/diffs/compare', kind: 'http', disposition: 'RELOCATE', door: 'Diffs domain' }. Route tests use the HttpRouter.toHttpEffect + HttpServerRequest.fromWeb harness from knowledge-viewer.test.ts with a no-remote fixture repo (PRD WI-6 step 5).

narrative.Action: PRD WI-9. New component DiffCompareBar({ repoPath, base, head, mode, error?, onApply }). It fetches /api/diffs/refs?repo=<repoPath> with useQuery (queryKey ['diff-refs', repoPath]) and shows the JSON error string on a non-OK response. One row: base <input list> (aria-label 'Compare base ref'), two mode buttons labelled A..B (aria-label 'Two-dot compare') and A...B (aria-label 'Three-dot compare'), head <input list> (aria-label 'Compare head ref'), and a Compare button. One shared <datalist> lists local branches, remote branches, tags (value = name) and commits (value = shortSha, label = subject). Inputs start from the props; an empty head starts as HEAD. Compare or Enter calls onApply with trimmed values and the mode; Compare is disabled while base or head is empty. An error prop renders under the inputs. Native datalist only, no new dependency. Follow the dashboard style guide (no pill badges, no Inter).
